print_name, paper_goods_id, paper_type, print_count, page_count, print_side, total_pages, teacher_id, grade, class_id, class_name, operator, print_time, remark, status, out_id, attachment, result_img, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag,
#{printName}, #{paperGoodsId}, #{paperType}, #{printCount}, #{pageCount}, #{printSide}, #{totalPages}, #{teacherId}, #{grade}, #{classId}, #{className}, #{operator}, #{printTime}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{outId}, #{attachment}, #{resultImg}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{delFlag},
mapper.update: update edu_print_record set del_flag = '2' where print_id = #{printId}

update edu_print_record set del_flag = '2' where print_id in
#{printId}
mapper.select:
select coalesce(sum(case when status != '2' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as totalJobs, coalesce(sum(case when status != '2' then print_count else 0 end), 0) as totalPrintCount, coalesce(sum(case when status != '2' then total_pages else 0 end), 0) as totalPages, coalesce(sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as completedJobs, coalesce(sum(case when status = '1' then print_count else 0 end), 0) as completedPrintCount, coalesce(sum(case when status = '1' then total_pages else 0 end), 0) as completedPages, coalesce(sum(case when status = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pendingJobs, coalesce(sum(case when status = '0' then print_count else 0 end), 0) as pendingPrintCount, coalesce(sum(case when status = '0' then total_pages else 0 end), 0) as pendingPages, coalesce(sum(case when status = '2' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as cancelledJobs, coalesce(sum(case when status = '2' then total_pages else 0 end), 0) as cancelledPages from edu_print_record
and del_flag = '0' and status = #{status} and print_name like concat('%', #{printName}, '%') and paper_type = #{paperType} and grade = #{grade} and teacher_id = #{teacherId}
and date_format(print_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(print_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%y%m%d')

select coalesce(paper_type, '未指定') as paperType, count(1) as jobCount, coalesce(sum(total_pages), 0) as totalPages, coalesce(sum(print_count), 0) as totalPrintCount from edu_print_record
and del_flag = '0' and status = #{status} and status != '2' and print_name like concat('%', #{printName}, '%') and grade = #{grade} and teacher_id = #{teacherId}
and date_format(print_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(print_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%y%m%d')
group by paper_type order by totalPages desc

select coalesce(nullif(grade, ''), '全校通用') as grade, count(1) as jobCount, coalesce(sum(total_pages), 0) as totalPages, coalesce(sum(print_count), 0) as totalPrintCount from edu_print_record
and del_flag = '0' and status = #{status} and status != '2' and print_name like concat('%', #{printName}, '%') and paper_type = #{paperType} and teacher_id = #{teacherId}
and date_format(print_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(print_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%y%m%d')
group by grade order by totalPages desc

select coalesce(u.nick_name, t.teacher_name, '未知教师') as teacherName, coalesce(u.subject, t.subject, '学科通用') as subject, count(1) as jobCount, coalesce(sum(r.total_pages), 0) as totalPages, coalesce(sum(r.print_count), 0) as totalPrintCount from edu_print_record r left join sys_user u on r.teacher_id = u.user_id left join edu_teacher t on r.teacher_id = t.teacher_id
and r.del_flag = '0' and r.status = #{status} and r.status != '2' and r.print_name like concat('%', #{printName}, '%') and r.grade = #{grade} and r.paper_type = #{paperType} and r.teacher_id = #{teacherId}
and date_format(r.print_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(r.print_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%y%m%d')
group by r.teacher_id, coalesce(u.nick_name, t.teacher_name), coalesce(u.subject, t.subject) order by totalPages desc limit 10

select date_format(print_time, '%Y-%m') as month, count(1) as jobCount, coalesce(sum(total_pages), 0) as totalPages, coalesce(sum(print_count), 0) as totalPrintCount from edu_print_record where del_flag = '0' and status != '2' and print_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 month) group by month order by month asc
